headline: Gulet. Not gullet.
primaryText:
One letter separates a very good boy's afternoon from your best holiday yet.

A gulet is a traditional wooden vessel chartered for the Adriatic — your own crew, your own route, a new bay every morning.
Spend your time with family, friends or colleagues on an unforgettable maritime adventure.

All you need to do is pick your dates and your vessel.
We do the rest.
whyItWorks: A pun on two near-identical words (gulet vs gullet, a dog's chew stick) sets up a small puzzle that makes people stop and smile. The side-by-side picture of sticks and a boat explains the joke at a glance, and it gently teaches what a gulet is. The ad has been live for several months, which suggests the playful tone is earning its keep.
